construction.implementation_origin: Newly authored isolated Python reference implementation

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, query, timezone-aware now, allowlisted_hosts, products, documents, requirements; optional events=[], limit=10, half_life_days=30
shared_schema.product: id, title, description, optional tags, source_urls
shared_schema.document: url, text; all content is supplied synthetic fixture data
shared_schema.stage: schema_version, status, stage, candidates; candidate fields accumulate without replacing prior evidence
shared_schema.validation: Shared ValidationError, input validation, stage envelope validation, source attribution, exact quoted offsets, requirement/evidence consistency, finite scores
shared_schema.errors: CLI emits one JSON error object and exits 2 for file, decoding, JSON and validation errors; success exits 0

cross_stage_handoffs: semantic -> web: validated product IDs, relevance scores and matched tokens define the only candidates researched
web -> review: validated retrieved sources, requirement-specific quotations, character offsets and missing URLs
review -> behavior: validated checks, gaps and coverage enter final ranking; all source evidence and gaps remain visible

behavior.semantic: Inverted token index with query-token recall score, deterministic product-ID tie breaks, top-k. Optional injected embedding callable receives query plus catalog texts and returns equal-length finite numeric vectors. Hybrid score is 0.6 lexical + 0.4 nonnegative cosine; zero vectors contribute zero.
behavior.web: Offline fixture retrieval only. Exact lowercase allowlisted HTTPS hosts, default/443 port, no credentials, fragments, whitespace or backslashes. Unknown permitted URLs become traceable missing sources. No network access.
behavior.review: All requirement keyword tokens must appear in one source sentence. Coverage requires min_sources distinct URLs. Quotations retain source URL and exact offsets. Missing evidence produces explicit gaps. Keyword matches are not semantic entailment, certification or fact verification.
behavior.personalization: Browse weight 1, purchase weight 3; decay=2^(-age_days/half_life_days). Product affinity=sum/(1+sum). Active-history score=0.55 semantic + 0.25 review coverage + 0.20 affinity. Cold-start score=0.70 semantic + 0.30 coverage when no positive candidate history. Future/unknown-product events rejected.
behavior.edge_cases: No search matches produce empty downstream stages. Empty requirements yield vacuous coverage=1. Events outside current candidates trigger cold start. Repeated events count as independent observations. Stable ID tie breaks and injected now guarantee deterministic output.

test_outcomes.cli_output: One valid JSON object with status ok
test_outcomes.error_paths: Missing file, usage, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, invalid schema and nonfinite values emit JSON status error with exit 2
